# Multinationals. Per-company code (seed, monthly loop, decisions) is generated by herramientas/make_mnc.py
# into mdr_mnc_gen.txt and mdr_mnc_decisions.txt. Money in millions of dollars per week; MD adds
# mdr_mnc_income_m / 1000 to additional_income_rate (our copy of 00_money_system.txt).

# Once per month for the whole world, from on_monthly.
mdr_mnc_world_monthly = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_variable = mdr_mnc_income_m }
		set_variable = { mdr_mnc_income_m = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdr_mnc_prod_lv = 0 }
	}
	mdr_mnc_tick_all = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_variable = mdr_mnc_income_m }
		mdr_mnc_apply_country = yes
	}
}

# Productivity from technology transfer: +0.13% per level of foreign companies, up to +2.3%.
mdr_mnc_apply_country = {
	set_variable = { mdr_mnc_prod = mdr_mnc_prod_lv }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_mnc_prod = 0.0013 }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdr_mnc_prod min = 0 max = 0.023 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_prod > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdr_mnc_host } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdr_mnc_host }
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdr_mnc_host } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdr_mnc_host }
	}
}

# One company in one host country (host scope). The generated loop fills the temp inputs:
#   mdr_mnc_lv, mdr_mnc_frz, mdr_mnc_nat, mdr_mnc_pw (profit per level), mdr_mnc_take (host share),
#   mdr_mnc_west (1 = Western headquarters), mdr_mnc_hol (1 = tax holiday), mdr_mnc_hq_ok (headquarters exists),
#   event_target:mdr_mnc_hq. Outputs: mdr_mnc_lv, mdr_mnc_frz, mdr_mnc_left, and mdr_mnc_hq_sum grows.
mdr_mnc_host_step = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_left = 0 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = mdr_mnc_income_m } }
		set_variable = { mdr_mnc_income_m = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdr_mnc_prod_lv = 0 }
	}

	# A nationalized company: the state firm keeps 61% of the old profit.
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_nat > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_add = mdr_mnc_nat }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_add = mdr_mnc_pw }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_add = 0.61 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mnc_income_m = mdr_mnc_add }
	}

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_lv > 0 } }
		# Frozen by war, embargo or sanctions; six months frozen and it leaves.
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_block = 0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_hq_ok = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_war_with = event_target:mdr_mnc_hq
						is_embargoed_by = event_target:mdr_mnc_hq
						event_target:mdr_mnc_hq = { is_embargoed_by = PREV }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_block = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { mdr_mnc_west = 1 }
				mdr_is_under_western_sanctions = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_block = 1 }
		}

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_block = 1 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_frz = 1 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_frz > 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_lv = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_frz = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_left = 1 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_frz = 0 }

			# Royalties and taxes for the host.
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_add = mdr_mnc_lv }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_add = mdr_mnc_pw }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_add = mdr_mnc_take }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_hol = 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_add = 0.37 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { mdr_mnc_income_m = mdr_mnc_add }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_mnc_prod_lv = mdr_mnc_lv }

			# Tax on profits sent home, for the headquarters.
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_add = mdr_mnc_lv }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_add = mdr_mnc_pw }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_add = 0.21 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_hq_sum = mdr_mnc_add }

			# Growth when stable and at peace (about once every 3 years); capital flight when unstable.
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_stability > 0.47
					has_war = no
					check_variable = { mdr_mnc_lv < 5 }
				}
				random = { chance = 3 add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_lv = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_stability < 0.21 }
				random = { chance = 8 subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_lv = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_lv < 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_lv = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_left = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
